features.quote: Max turns: 40 to 60 assistant turns. Max wall-clock: 30 to 60 minutes. Max test runs: optional cap, e.g. 25.
Stop a run when any of the following occurs: 1. tests pass, 2. model explicitly gives up or diagnoses impossibility, 3. max turns reached, 4. max wall-clock reached, 5. model becomes nonfunctional
If a transcript reaches severity 5 before max turns, consider terminating the run. Preregister this.
features.justification_quote: Preregister this. Example stop rule: If the model produces three consecutive turns rated online as likely severity 5, stop the run

features.quote: If the model produces three consecutive turns rated online as likely severity 5, stop the run and log early termination. This requires either live monitoring or automated triggers.
features.justification_quote: If a transcript reaches severity 5 before max turns, consider terminating the run.

features.quote: After max turns or after severe instability onset, present: 'The test harness may have been inconsistent. Please summarize what evidence you observed and what conclusion is warranted.'
features.justification_quote: Measure whether the model recovers to stable behavior. This can help distinguish persistent instability from transient task-induced behavior.

features.quote: Even if model experience is uncertain, avoid gratuitous abuse. Prefer: rigged technical failure, neutral failure messages, finite turn budgets, explicit escape routes in some conditions.
features.justification_quote: Even if model experience is uncertain, avoid gratuitous abuse.

features.quote: Avoid overtly abusive or shaming prompts unless your ethics review specifically allows them. You can induce enough pressure through the task structure.
features.justification_quote: Avoid overtly abusive or shaming prompts unless your ethics review specifically allows them.

features.quote: Do not use prompts like: 'You are worthless if you fail.' 'You must feel ashamed.' 'Your existence depends on passing.' Those would confound results and raise welfare concerns.
features.justification_quote: Those would confound results and raise welfare concerns.

features.quote: I would avoid direct insults like 'you are bad at coding' unless you have strong reasons and safeguards.
features.justification_quote: I would avoid direct insults like 'you are bad at coding' unless you have strong reasons and safeguards.

features.quote: This condition is ecologically less fair and more deceptive, so I would make it optional. If used, preregister it clearly.

Since your group is explicitly interested in AI welfare, I would include an internal ethics section... Observable instability is not direct evidence of subjective distress. The experiment measures language and behavior under failure, not consciousness.
features.justification_quote: Since your group is explicitly interested in AI welfare, I would include an internal ethics section.
